# Supabase connection details for STAR:DOM  --  COPY THIS FILE, DO NOT EDIT IT
#
#   copy tools\supabase-credentials.example.txt  ->  tools\supabase-credentials.txt
#
# Everything below is already filled in except ONE thing: the password.
# Just paste it after "SUPABASE_DB_URL=" and save.
#
# WHERE TO GET THE PASSWORD
#   Supabase -> Project Settings -> Database -> Connection string
#   -> click the "Session pooler" tab (NOT "Transaction pooler")
#   -> copy the password out of it
#   If you have never seen it, press "Reset database password" and set a new one.
#
# WHY THE POOLER AND NOT db.pykhzrpgdszcwvpydebt.supabase.co
#   The direct host resolves to an IPv6 address only, and this machine has no
#   IPv6 route, so it can never connect. The pooler has IPv4 and was verified
#   to reach Supabase from here.
#
# WHY "Session pooler" (port 5432) AND NOT "Transaction pooler" (port 6543)
#   Npgsql uses server-side prepared statements. PgBouncer in transaction mode
#   does not support those, so the app would fail on every query. Session mode
#   is a plain proxy and behaves exactly like a direct connection.
#
# Keep it on ONE line. No quotes, no spaces.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SUPABASE_DB_URL=postgresql://postgres.pykhzrpgdszcwvpydebt:PASTE_PASSWORD_HERE@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres
